title: Three-course Python assessment suite
summary: Three current postsecondary Python courses assess learners through 297 introductory multiple-choice questions plus an intermediate course with quizzes, tests, 32 projects, and 69 coding activities. The study submitted the same 599 assessment items to GPT models and used each course's automated grading rules.
